card.name: Prepositions after spread or change verbs
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly prepositions like in, into, over, around and by, that come right after a verb or noun about spreading, change or time and lead into a place or date. Seen in general web prose on history, science and world events.

modes.label: Place or spread
modes.description: A preposition after a spreading or appearance phrase, introducing a region.
modes.example: sudden appearance of plant cultivation<< in>> the Near East around 10,

modes.label: Time span
modes.description: A preposition or gap after a phrase about change over years, leading into a period or date.
modes.example: rapid and profound change to the global environment that has taken place<< over>> the last fifty years or so
